# data frames
```{r}
pfd_md = fread(file.path(data_dir, "pfd_metadata.tsv"))
pfd_md2 = pfd_md %>%
  distinct(representative, .keep_all = T) %>%
  mutate(
    mobs_Name = str_replace_all(mobs_Name, ",\\s*", ", "), # correct this tomorrow
    args = str_replace_all(args, ",\\s*", ", "),
    MGEs = str_replace_all(MGEs, ";\\s*", ", ")
   ) %>%
  filter(db == "MFD") # uncomment to filter for mfd
  
ptu = pfd_md2 %>%
  mutate(ptu = na_if(ptu, "")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ptu)) %>%
  select(representative, ptu, mobs_Name, rps, args, replicon_type, defense_type, defense_subtype, taxa_gtdb, st_hab1) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ptu)) %>%
  group_by(ptu) %>%
  mutate(ptu_size = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(ptu_size >= 2)
  
dptu = pfd_md2 %>%
  mutate(ptu = na_if(ptu, "")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(dptu)) %>%
  select(representative, dptu, mobs_Name, rps, args, replicon_type, defense_type, defense_subtype, taxa_gtdb, st_hab1) %>%
  filter(!is.na(dptu)) %>%
  group_by(dptu) %>%
  mutate(dptu_size = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(dptu_size >= 2)
```

# replicon subtype
```{r}
replicon_family = function(x) {
  x = as.character(x)
  if (is.na(x) || !nzchar(x)) return(NA_character_)

  toks = unlist(strsplit(x, "[,;\\s]+"))
  toks = toks[nzchar(toks)]
  # strip parentheses payloads like IncFII(pHN7A8) -> IncFII, p0111(something) -> p0111
  toks = sub("\\(.*?\\)", "", toks)

  map_token = function(tok) {
    tl = tolower(tok)

    # special fixes
    if (tl %in% c("fii","fia")) return("IncF")
    if (tl %in% c("inca/c","incc","inca/c2")) return("IncC")
    if (tl == "incl/m") return("IncL/M")
    if (grepl("eudo\\)$", tok, ignore.case = TRUE)) return("IncF")

    # IncB/O/K/Z superfamily
    if (tl %in% c("incb","inck","inco","incz","incb/ok/z")) return("IncB/O/K/Z")

    # Col-like
    if (startsWith(tl, "col")) return("Col")

    # Standard Inc families (collapse to family)
    if (startsWith(tl, "incf"))  return("IncF")
    if (startsWith(tl, "inci"))  return("IncI")
    if (startsWith(tl, "inchi")) return("IncHI")
    if (startsWith(tl, "incn"))  return("IncN")
    if (startsWith(tl, "incp"))  return("IncP")
    if (startsWith(tl, "incq"))  return("IncQ")
    if (startsWith(tl, "incx"))  return("IncX")
    if (startsWith(tl, "incl"))  return("IncL")
    if (startsWith(tl, "incm"))  return("IncM")
    if (startsWith(tl, "inct"))  return("IncT")
    if (startsWith(tl, "incu"))  return("IncU")
    if (startsWith(tl, "incw"))  return("IncW")
    if (startsWith(tl, "incy"))  return("IncY")
    if (startsWith(tl, "incr"))  return("IncR")

    # Rep* (keep coarse bucket)
    if (startsWith(tl, "rep"))   return("Rep")

    # pXXXX (DO NOT collapse to "p"; group as subtype-like)
    # e.g. p0111 -> p0111-like, pSM22 -> pSM22-like
    if (grepl("^p[0-9A-Za-z]", tok)) return(paste0(tok, "-like"))

    # keep token if nothing matches
    tok
  }

  out = vapply(toks, map_token, character(1))
  out = out[!duplicated(out)]
  if (length(out) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  paste(out, collapse = ",")
}

replicon_subtype = function(x) {
  x = as.character(x)
  if (is.na(x) || !nzchar(x)) return(NA_character_)

  # remove parentheses payload before splitting
  x = gsub("\\(.*?\\)", "", x)

  toks = unlist(strsplit(x, "[,;\\s]+"))
  toks = toks[nzchar(toks)]

  out = unique(toks)
  if (length(out) == 0) return(NA_character_)

  paste(out, collapse = ",")
}
```

# replicons
```{r}
replicons = pfd_md2 %>%
  select(representative, ptu, dptu, replicon_type) %>%
  separate_rows(replicon_type, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
  mutate(
    replicon_family = sapply(replicon_type, replicon_family),
    replicon_subtype = sapply(replicon_type, replicon_subtype)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    replicon_broad = case_when(
      is.na(replicon_family) ~ NA_character_,
      replicon_family == "Col" ~ "Col-like small-plasmid replicons",
      replicon_family %in% c(
        "IncF", "IncHI", "IncI", "IncL/M", "IncN", "IncR",
        "IncX", "IncY", "IncC", "IncB/O/K/Z"
      ) ~ "Enterobacterales-associated Inc replicons",
      replicon_family %in% c("IncP", "IncQ", "IncW", "IncU", "IncT") ~
        "Broad-host-range / other Inc replicons",
      replicon_family == "Rep" |
        str_detect(replicon_family, "^p.+-like$") ~
        "Rep/p-type replicons",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(representative) %>%
  summarise(
    replicon_type = paste(unique(na.omit(replicon_type)), collapse = ", "),
    replicon_family = paste(unique(na.omit(replicon_family)), collapse = ", "),
    replicon_subtype = paste(unique(na.omit(replicon_subtype)), collapse = ", "),
    replicon_broad = paste(unique(na.omit(replicon_broad)), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% right_join(pfd_md2 %>% select(representative, ptu, dptu))
```

# img/pr environment (no na)
```{r}
imgpr = fread(file.path(data_dir, "IMGPR_plasmid_data.tsv")) 
imgpr2 = imgpr %>% 
  select(plasmid_id, ecosystem) %>%
  rename(member_id = plasmid_id) %>%
  right_join(pfd_md %>% select(member_id, representative, ptu, dptu), by = "member_id") %>%
   mutate(
    ecosystem = trimws(ecosystem),
    ecosystem = na_if(ecosystem, "")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    environment = case_when(
      is.na(ecosystem) ~ NA_character_,
      str_detect(ecosystem, "^Host-associated;Mammals: Human") ~ "Host-associated; Mammals: Human",
      str_detect(ecosystem, "^Host-associated;Mammals") ~ "Host-associated; Mammals",
      str_detect(ecosystem, "^Host-associated;Arthropoda: Insects") ~ "Host-associated; Arthropoda: Insects",
      str_detect(ecosystem, "^Host-associated;Plants") ~ "Host-associated; Plants",
      str_detect(ecosystem, "^Environmental;Aquatic;Marine") ~ "Environmental; Aquatic; Marine",
      str_detect(ecosystem, "^Environmental;Aquatic;Freshwater") ~ "Environmental; Aquatic; Freshwater",
      str_detect(ecosystem, "^Environmental;Aquatic;Non-marine Saline and Alkaline") ~ 
        "Environmental; Aquatic; Non-marine Saline and Alkaline",
      str_detect(ecosystem, "^Environmental;Terrestrial;Soil") ~ "Environmental; Terrestrial; Soil",
      str_detect(ecosystem, "^Engineered;Bioreactor") ~ "Engineered; Bioreactor",
      str_detect(ecosystem, "^Engineered;Built environment") ~ "Engineered; Built environment",
      str_detect(ecosystem, "^Engineered;Wastewater|^Engineered;WWTP") ~ "Engineered; Wastewater / WWTP",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ecosystem)) %>%
  group_by(representative) %>%
  mutate(ecosystem = paste(unique(na.omit(ecosystem)), collapse = ", ")) %>%
  mutate(environment = paste(unique(na.omit(environment)), collapse = ", ")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(representative, .keep_all = T)
  
```

```{r}
  "Class",                  "taxa_class",
  "Order",                  "taxa_order",
  "Family",                 "taxa_family",
  "Genus",                  "taxa_genus",
  #"Species",               "taxa_species",
  #"replicon_subtype",      "replicons_no_na",
  "replicon_type",          "replicons_no_na",
  #"replicon_family",       "replicons_no_na",
  #"replicon_broad",        "replicons_no_na",
  "ecosystem",              "imgpr2",
  #"environment",           "imgpr2"
)

group_cols = c("ptu", "dptu")


# helper functions
write_tsv = function(x, path) {
  write.table(
    x,
    file = path,
    sep = "\t",
    quote = FALSE,
    row.names = FALSE,
    na = ""
  )
}

safe_name = function(x) {
  x %>%
    gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_", .) %>%
    gsub("_+", "_", .) %>%
    gsub("^_|_$", "", .)
}

parse_features = function(x) {
  x = as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x)] = ""
  
  items = unlist(strsplit(x, ",", fixed = TRUE))
  items = trimws(items)
  
  items = items[items != ""]
  items = items[toupper(items) != "NONE"]
  
  sort(unique(items))
}

jaccard = function(a, b) {
  uni = union(a, b)
  
  if (length(uni) == 0L) return(1)
  
  length(intersect(a, b)) / length(uni)
}

pairwise_jaccard_values = function(sets) {
  n = length(sets)
  
  if (n < 2L) return(numeric())
  
  idx = combn(seq_len(n), 2)
  
  map_dbl(seq_len(ncol(idx)), function(i) {
    a = sets[[idx[1, i]]]
    b = sets[[idx[2, i]]]
    
    jaccard(a, b)
  })
}

weighted_sd = function(x, w) {
  
  keep = !is.na(x) & !is.na(w) & w > 0
  
  x = x[keep]
  w = w[keep]
  
  if (length(x) < 2L) return(NA_real_)
  
  w = w / sum(w)
  
  weighted_mean = sum(w * x)
  
  sqrt(sum(w * (x - weighted_mean)^2))
}

count_total_feature_info = function(df_source, feature_col) {
  
  tmp = df_source %>%
    select(
      representative,
      feature = all_of(feature_col)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(representative)) %>%
    distinct()
  
  tibble(
    n_plasmids_total = n_distinct(tmp$representative),
    n_features_total = length(unique(unlist(map(tmp$feature, parse_features))))
  )
}

count_features_from_string = function(x) {
  
  values = unlist(strsplit(x, ",\\s*"))
  values = values[!is.na(values)]
  values = trimws(values)
  values = values[values != ""]
  
  length(unique(values))
}


# prepare group info once
group_info = pfd_md2 %>%
  select(representative, ptu, dptu) %>%
  distinct()


# core function
compute_jaccard_per_group = function(group_col, feature_col, df_source, df_name) {
  
  sets_full = df_source %>%
    select(
      representative,
      feature = all_of(feature_col)
    ) %>%
    left_join(group_info, by = "representative") %>%
    select(
      representative,
      group_value = all_of(group_col),
      feature
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(representative), !is.na(group_value)) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    group_by(group_value, representative) %>%
    summarise(
      set = list(parse_features(feature)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  grouped_sets = sets_full %>%
    group_by(group_value) %>%
    group_split()
  
  scores = future_map_dfr(
    grouped_sets,
    function(group_df) {
      
      n_members = nrow(group_df)
      n_pairs = choose(n_members, 2)
      
      pairwise_values = pairwise_jaccard_values(group_df$set)
      features_group = sort(unique(unlist(group_df$set)))
      
      tibble(
        group_value = group_df$group_value[1],
        n_groups = 1,
        n_plasmids = n_members,
        n_pairs = n_pairs,
        n_features = length(features_group),
        features_used = paste(features_group, collapse = ", "),
        
        jaccard = mean(pairwise_values),
        
        sd_jaccard = sd(pairwise_values)
      )
    },
    .options = furrr_options(seed = FALSE)
  ) %>%
    filter(n_plasmids >= 2)
  
  if (nrow(scores) == 0) {
    return(
      tibble(
        group = character(),
        group_value = character(),
        trait = character(),
        df_name = character(),
        n_groups = numeric(),
        n_plasmids = numeric(),
        n_features = numeric(),
        features_used = character(),
        jaccard = numeric(),
        sd_jaccard = numeric(),
        weight = numeric()
      )
    )
  }
  
  scores = scores %>%
    mutate(
      weight = n_pairs / sum(n_pairs),
      group = group_col,
      trait = feature_col,
      df_name = df_name
    ) %>%
    select(
      group,
      group_value,
      trait,
      df_name,
      n_groups,
      n_plasmids,
      n_features,
      features_used,
      jaccard,
      sd_jaccard,
      weight
    )
  
  scores
}


compute_one_feature_summary = function(feature_col, df_name, df_source) {
  
  message("Starting: ", df_name, " | ", feature_col)
  
  total_feature_info = count_total_feature_info(
    df_source = df_source,
    feature_col = feature_col
  )
  
  per_group = map_dfr(group_cols, function(group_col) {
    compute_jaccard_per_group(
      group_col = group_col,
      feature_col = feature_col,
      df_source = df_source,
      df_name = df_name
    )
  })
  
  summary = per_group %>%
    group_by(group, trait, df_name) %>%
    summarise(
      n_groups = n(),
      n_plasmids = sum(n_plasmids),
      n_features = count_features_from_string(features_used),
      
      mean_jaccard = mean(jaccard),
      
      sd_jaccard_unweighted = sd(jaccard),
      
      weighted_jaccard = sum(jaccard * weight),
      
      sd_jaccard_weighted = weighted_sd(
        x = jaccard,
        w = weight
      ),
      
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    bind_cols(total_feature_info)
  
  message("Finished: ", df_name, " | ", feature_col)
  
  list(
    summary = summary,
    per_group = per_group
  )
}


# run each trait
completed_summaries = list()
error_log = list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(feature_sources))) {
  
  current = feature_sources[i, ]

  feature_col = current$feature_col
  df_name = current$df_name

###   summary_file = file.path(

  tryCatch(
    {
      result_out = compute_one_feature_summary(

      )
      
      summary_out = result_out$summary
      per_group_out = result_out$per_group
      
### write_tsv(summary_out, summary_file)
### write_tsv(per_group_out, per_group_file)
      
      completed_summaries[[length(completed_summaries) + 1]] = summary_out
    },
    error = function(e) {
      
      error_message = paste0(

        "df_name: ", df_name, "\n",
        "feature_col: ", feature_col, "\n\n",
        conditionMessage(e), "\n"
      )
      
### writeLines(error_message, error_file)
      
      error_log[[length(error_log) + 1]] <<- tibble(

        df_name = df_name,
        feature_col = feature_col,
        error = conditionMessage(e)
      )
      
      message("ERROR: ", df_name, " | ", feature_col)
      message(conditionMessage(e))
    }
  )
  
  rm(df_source)
  gc()
}
```

```{r}
# packages
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggtext)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)
library(grid)


# theme
figure_theme = theme_bw(base_size = 12, base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )

# count the assigned plasmids for each source
ranks = c("Domain", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species")
sources = c("MFD", "IMG/PR", "PLSDB")
pfd = fread(file.path(data_dir, "pfd_metadata.tsv")) %>%
  distinct(representative, .keep_all = TRUE)

totals = pfd %>%
  count(db, name = "total")

taxa_counts = pfd %>%
  select(db, taxa_gtdb) %>%
  separate(taxa_gtdb, into = ranks, sep = ";", fill = "right") %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(ranks), names_to = "rank", values_to = "taxon") %>%
  # exclude missing assignments and root at each rank
  mutate(taxon = trimws(sub("^[a-z-]_+", "", taxon))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(taxon), !tolower(taxon) %in% c("", "na", "root")) %>%
  count(db, rank) %>%
  complete(db = sources, rank = ranks, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  left_join(totals, by = "db") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(comma(n), " (", percent(n / total, accuracy = 0.1), ")"))

table_data = bind_rows(
  totals %>% mutate(rank = "No. of plasmids", label = comma(total)),
  taxa_counts
) %>%
  mutate(
    db = factor(db, levels = sources),
    row = match(rank, rev(c("No. of plasmids", ranks)))
  )

# table
p_table = ggplot(table_data, aes(db, row)) +
  geom_tile(fill = "white", colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), size = 10 / .pt,
            hjust = 1, nudge_x = 0.44) +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top", expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:8, labels = rev(c("No. of plasmids", ranks)),
                     limits = c(0.5, 8.5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  figure_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))

# use the saved jaccard results
plot_data = fread(file.path(data_dir, "traits_mfd.tsv")) %>%
  filter(trait %in% ranks, df_name %in% paste0("taxa_", tolower(ranks))) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = c("ptu", "dptu"), labels = c("PTU", "dPTU")),
    row = match(trait, rev(ranks)),
    label = sprintf(
      "<b>%.2f</b><span style='font-size:10pt'> ± %.2f<br>(%s; %s; %s)</span>",
      weighted_jaccard, sd_jaccard_weighted,
      comma(n_features), comma(n_groups), comma(n_plasmids)
    )
  )

rank_labels = plot_data %>%
  distinct(row, trait, n_features_total) %>%
  arrange(row) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(trait, " (", comma(n_features_total), ")"))

# leave the first row empty for the colour scale
p_tax = ggplot(plot_data, aes(as.numeric(group), row, fill = weighted_jaccard)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_richtext(aes(label = label), size = 12 / .pt,
                colour = "black", fill = NA, label.color = NA,
                label.padding = unit(0, "pt")) +
  # put the heading at the same height as the table headings
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(1, 2), labels = c("PTU", "dPTU"),
    limits = c(0.5, 2.5), expand = c(0, 0),
    sec.axis = dup_axis(breaks = 1.5, labels = "Taxonomy", name = NULL)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = rank_labels$row, labels = rank_labels$label,
                     limits = c(0.5, 8.5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    limits = c(0, 1), name = "Jaccard index",
    breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1), labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.01),
    guide = guide_colourbar(direction = "horizontal", title.position = "top",
                           barwidth = unit(4, "cm"), barheight = unit(0.25, "cm"))
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  figure_theme +
  theme(
    axis.text.x.top = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 3, unit = "mm"),
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.5, 1),
    legend.justification = c(0.5, 1),
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    legend.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

# page size and margins
figure_width = 21
figure_height = 14
figure_margin = margin(0, 3, 0, 3, unit = "mm")

figure_plot = p_table + p_tax +
  plot_layout(widths = c(3, 2)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A",
                  theme = theme(plot.margin = figure_margin,
                                plot.tag = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"))) &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"))

# save figure
dir.create(figure_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, "si_f6.png"), figure_plot,
       width = figure_width, height = figure_height,
       units = "cm", dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```
